title: 28 February 1961: Live: Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ eighth show at Litherland Town Hall, where they had given a triumphant homecoming performance on 27 December 1960, following their first trip to Hamburg.

The Beatles played at the venue on 20 separate occasions between December 1960 and 9 November 1961.

Earlier on this date The Beatles had played a lunchtime show at the Cavern Club, and given an evening performance at the Cassanova Club in Liverpool. The Litherland engagement was promoted by Brian Kelly, who ran Beekay Promotions.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 1999: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Park West, Chicago
  • 1976: Mixing: Cook Of The House, Time To Hide by Wings
  • 1972: Recording, mixing: Sisters, O Sisters by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1972: US single release: Give Ireland Back To The Irish by Wings
  • 1970: Mixing: For You Blue
  • 1970: Mixing: Oo You by Paul McCartney
  • 1967: Recording: Lucy In The Sky With Diamonds
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
  • 1964: Radio: From Us To You
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Granada Cinema, Shrewsbury – Lennon and McCartney write From Me To You
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cassanova Club, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
